supersedes.reason: With Slurm --export=ALL, an inherited caller value takes precedence over an explicit NAME=value. Revision 1 did not set or verify the sbatch caller environment, so an inherited empty or zero PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE could permit the task-local __pycache__ that the publication gate correctly rejects.

bound_publication_gate.test_result: 94 passed; Ruff format/check and py_compile passed

frozen_submission.slurm_all_precedence_handling: The leading env assignments atomically set the sbatch caller values to the same values repeated in --export. Therefore Slurm's documented ALL precedence cannot substitute inherited empty, zero, localized, or warning-suppressing values.

rationale: The frozen diagnostic dynamically imports the staged producer. Without effective PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, Python creates a task-root __pycache__, as completed job 304002 demonstrates. PYTHONWARNINGS=default and LC_ALL=C make the exact warning and coreutils log grammar deterministic. The publication gate requires the complete copied directory set to contain only artifacts and sbatch_logs, so launch prevention must be explicit rather than deleting or selectively omitting post-run members.

post_run_copy_contract.canonical_manifest: ASCII; root-relative ./ paths; lexicographically sorted; one lowercase SHA-256 and filename per LF-terminated line; manifest excludes itself

prelaunch_checks: AGA private DNS and SSH resolve.
The logical and physical task paths are both absent before staging.
The remote execution source-tree digest matches the frozen launch manifest.
Every staged root file and prior-artifact sidecar matches the frozen manifest.
Only artifacts and sbatch_logs directories exist before submission.
No Python command is run from or against a staged task-local module before sbatch.
The exact env-plus-sbatch argv above is used from the exact working directory and the returned job ID is numeric.
